description: Downtown Dallas to host Women’s March and March for Life on Saturday by: DMN, Dana Branham Thousands are expected to gather Saturday in downtown Dallas for two marches that commemorate anniversaries central to women’s lives. The Dallas Women’s March celebrates achievements made since millions of women gathered worldwide for the inaugural Women’s March events last year.…
